title: What the user does · Create → Register → Login
caption: Follow the typed entries and illustrated security-key prompts.
voice: Follow account creation, security key registration, and login. Watch the typed entries and illustrated security prompts.

title: 01 · Creating a user
caption: Administrator enters the token, root password, new username, and user password.
voice: Start with Create database user. The administrator enters the demo administrator token and root password. Then choose a new username, and type the password that this user will use for registration and login. Passwords appear as dots. Leave the drop account option unchecked, and click Create MySQL user. The confirmation tells you to register the user's security key next.

title: 02 · Registration: enter the account details
caption: Enter the new username and password, then click Register in browser.
voice: Move to registration. Type the username and password for the account just created. Click Register in browser to open the security key prompt.

title: 02 · Registration: security key → PIN → touch
caption: Illustrated browser/device prompt: enter the key PIN, then touch the physical token.
voice: Choose the connected security key. The browser or operating system asks for the key's security PIN. Enter that PIN in the security prompt, then continue. Next, touch the security key when it flashes. The PIN belongs to the key; it is different from the database password. These illustrated prompts show the sequence. The registration confirmation appears back in the application.

title: 03 · Login: enter the username and password
caption: Type the account password and click Authenticate to MySQL.
voice: To log in, enter the same username and database password. Click Authenticate to MySQL. The browser now requests the registered security key, which is the user's physical security token.

title: 03 · Login: touch the registered security key
caption: Login: database password + security-key touch. No PIN entry.
voice: Use the registered key and touch its flashing contact. Login uses your database password and security token, without entering a PIN. The key signs the authentication challenge automatically.

title: Signed in · Hello world
caption: Success: the account completes registration, authentication, and the SQL query.
voice: Success. Hello world appears with the authenticated account and connection details. The application screens are real; the database and security device are simulated for this walkthrough.
